It therefore stays at the floor while attention is parked on that opening token (19 of 20 single short sentences, 8 of 8 short two-sentence passages that share no content word, and 3 of 4 comma-separated lists of proper names measured at the floor), and fires at 0.5-1.2, up to 1.9 when the copied token is a rare fragment (name piece, numeral, CJK byte, code symbol), as soon as a copy lands on a content token - reliably in code/markup/SQL/JSON lines (7 of 8 short snippets) and in running prose of 30+ tokens (13 of 15 passages), and at the second occurrence of a repeated word, name or number, where it attends to the token that followed the earlier copy (induction: 'Commander Vasquez ...
